python - <<'PY'
import json, os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

with open('/app/benchmark/task_input.json') as f:
    task=json.load(f)
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data=json.load(f)

goal = task.get('goal', [''])[0] if isinstance(task.get('goal'), list) else task.get('goal','')
style = task.get('style','')

series = data['currency_depreciation_pct']['data']
# use 2024 values to tell strongest current insight
vals=[d for d in series if d['year']==2024]
vals=sorted(vals,key=lambda x:x['depreciation_pct'], reverse=True)

W,H=1800,1100
img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'#f7f9fc')
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# fonts
try:
    f_title=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',56)
    f_sub=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',30)
    f_axis=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',24)
    f_label=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',26)
    f_bold=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',26)
    f_small=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',20)
except:
    f_title=f_sub=f_axis=f_label=f_bold=f_small=ImageFont.load_default()

# title
main_title='Currency Depreciation in 2024 Across Emerging Markets'
subtitle='Highest annual currency losses cluster in Ghana and Pakistan, far above peers'
d.text((90,50), main_title, font=f_title, fill='#111827')
d.text((90,125), subtitle, font=f_sub, fill='#4b5563')

# plot area
left, top, right, bottom = 240, 230, 1640, 930
plot_w, plot_h = right-left, bottom-top

# axes
d.rectangle([left,top,right,bottom], outline='#d1d5db', width=2)

maxv=max(v['depreciation_pct'] for v in vals)
max_axis=70
for t in range(0,max_axis+1,10):
    y=bottom - (t/max_axis)*plot_h
    d.line([left,y,right,y], fill='#e5e7eb', width=1)
    d.text((170,y-12), f'{t}%', font=f_axis, fill='#6b7280')

# axis labels
d.text((left+plot_w//2-120,970),'Country',font=f_bold,fill='#374151')
# y label rotated
ylab='Depreciation (%)'
yt=Image.new('RGBA',(240,60),(0,0,0,0))
yd=ImageDraw.Draw(yt)
yd.text((0,0),ylab,font=f_bold,fill='#374151')
yt=yt.rotate(90, expand=1)
img.paste(yt,(40,top+plot_h//2-110),yt)

# colors
base='#3b82f6'
high='#ef4444'
second='#f97316'

n=len(vals)
bar_space=plot_w/n
bar_w=int(bar_space*0.62)

for i,row in enumerate(vals):
    x0=left + int(i*bar_space + (bar_space-bar_w)/2)
    x1=x0+bar_w
    h=(row['depreciation_pct']/max_axis)*plot_h
    y0=bottom-h
    color=base
    if i==0: color=high
    elif i==1: color=second
    d.rectangle([x0,y0,x1,bottom], fill=color)
    # value label
    val=f"{row['depreciation_pct']:.1f}%"
    tw=d.textlength(val,font=f_label)
    d.text((x0+(bar_w-tw)/2,y0-34),val,font=f_label,fill='#111827')
    # country label
    c=row['country']
    tw=d.textlength(c,font=f_label)
    d.text((x0+(bar_w-tw)/2,bottom+12),c,font=f_label,fill='#1f2937')

# legend
lx,ly=1170,70
d.rounded_rectangle([lx,ly,lx+520,ly+130], radius=14, fill='#ffffff', outline='#d1d5db', width=2)
d.rectangle([lx+20,ly+24,lx+52,ly+52], fill=high)
d.text((lx+64,ly+20),'Highest depreciation',font=f_small,fill='#111827')
d.rectangle([lx+20,ly+74,lx+52,ly+102], fill=base)
d.text((lx+64,ly+70),'Other countries',font=f_small,fill='#111827')

# source note + units
d.text((90,1030),'Source: /app/benchmark/source_data.json (currency_depreciation_pct, year=2024) | Unit: percent (%)',font=f_small,fill='#6b7280')

os.makedirs('/app/output', exist_ok=True)
img.save('/app/output/result.png')
print('saved /app/output/result.png')
print('goal:',goal)
print('style:',style)
PY
